title: Simple Cup Cozy
description: A stretchy coffee cup sleeve that replaces disposable cardboard ones. Eco-friendly and cute.
expectationText: A tiny project you can finish during one coffee break. The back-loop-only ribbing makes it stretchy enough to fit most cups.

steps.title: Start the ribbing
steps.instruction: Chain 10. This is the height of the cozy. Chain 1 more and turn.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Single crochet into the second chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 1 and turn.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 28
steps.instruction: Single crochet in the back loop only of each stitch across. Chain 1 and turn.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.instruction: Wrap the ribbed strip around your favourite mug. It should be snug but not tight. Add or remove rows as needed.

steps.title: Seam it
steps.instruction: Bring the two short ends together and slip stitch or sew them into a tube. Weave in the ends.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Slide it onto your cup and enjoy. Machine washable in cold water.
